one_liner: Cognition Labs' autonomous AI software engineer agent that can plan, write, and ship code in a sandboxed environment.

auth.evidence_quote: Legacy API keys (apk_ / apk_user_ prefix) are not supported by the Devin MCP server. You should use a service user API key instead.
auth.notes: Auth is via API key (cog_ prefixed service-user/org/personal-access tokens) sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>'; also requires an X-Org-Id header for org-scoped resources.

access.notes: Requires signing up for a Devin.ai account and generating an API key; Devin is a paid product (credits-based) purchasable online, not free.

api.notes: Vendor-published MCP server at mcp.devin.ai using Streamable HTTP, confirmed official in docs; operates on organization-level resources (sessions, playbooks, knowledge).

verdict.rationale: Official MCP server and REST API exist with straightforward API-key auth, but requires a paid Devin account/credits.
